svg.title: Xbox Controller — fillable paint-by-number page
svg.desc: A proportioned modern Xbox-style gamepad with offset analog sticks, D-pad, ABXY cluster, menu buttons, shoulder forms, grips, and centered Xbox button. Full-color library preview; opening the SVG changes paintable regions into a numbered worksheet.
